messages:
Leo M: Hi — quick reimbursement question. Took an overnight ferry and only got a small boarding receipt with a stamped time but no VAT invoice. Can I upload a phone photo? Also, I arrived at hotel late so not sure about dinner per diem.
Jordan (People Ops): Yup, phone photo is fine. Make sure it shows date, route, and amount. For missing VAT invoices we accept transport stubs.
Nina F (Finance): If the total > €150 we may ask for extra proof (card charge screenshot). For dinner per diem: on arrival day we pro-rate. If arrival was after 8pm, you can claim half-day meal allowance.
Leo M: Arrival was 22:10 local. I'll mark half for meals and attach the photo + card screenshot. Anything specific to tag in Expensify?
Jordan (People Ops): Tag as Travel:Transport and add note "overnight ferry, arrived 22:10". If receipt lacks merchant name write vendor name in notes.
Leo M: Submitted. Thanks!
ExpensesBot: Expense policy quick links — Travel & per diem: https://company.docs/expenses/travel ; Receipts: https://company.docs/expenses/receipts
